keys: `run: redirect` answers 303 See Other with `with.to` as the Location and ends the flow; in an async, scheduled or data-event run it does nothing. `to` is required text: a value that renders empty fails the step. There is no status key. `allow_hosts` is a list, or one comma-separated text, of the exact hostnames a templated `to:` may leave the app for: no wildcards, letter case ignored, and a URL written there counts as its hostname.
rule: A `to:` with any `${{ }}` or `:name` in it must render a path on this app (`/tasks/7`) or a URL on the app's own host, unless its host is in `allow_hosts`; anything else fails the step, so a stored or request value cannot send a visitor to another site. A `to:` written out in full is yours and may point anywhere except javascript:, data:, vbscript: and file:. The redirect line of step_types has the remaining cases.
yaml_example:
# flows/open-task.yaml - send the caller to the task's tracker, or to its page here
on:
  request:
    method: GET
    path: /api/tasks/:id/open
    auth: required
jobs:
  open:
    steps:
      - id: task
        run: sql
        expect_rows: "=1"
        with: { query: "SELECT id, tracker_url FROM tasks WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :user_id" }
      - if: ${{ steps.task.outputs.tracker_url }}
        run: redirect
        with:
          to: "${{ steps.task.outputs.tracker_url }}"   # a stored URL on another host
          allow_hosts: [tracker.example.com]            # the only hosts it may leave the app for
        else:                                           # runs when the if: above is false
          - run: redirect
            with:
              to: "/tasks/${{ steps.task.outputs.id }}"
